meta.note: Trees as [x, z, kind, surveyed] (surveyed 1 = an OpenStreetMap natural=tree or a tree of a mapped tree_row, 0 = synthesised). kind: sakura = cherry (Somei-yoshino: the palace moats on the Hanzomon / Chidorigafuchi side, Shiba Park and Zojo-ji, the Sumida terraces, small parks; pale pink in the level's season or plain green); ginkgo = the avenue ginkgos (Hibiya-dori, Gyoko-dori, Uchibori-dori, Sakurada-dori, Showa-dori: tall, narrow, gold in autumn); zelkova = keyaki street trees (Marunouchi Naka-dori, Chuo-dori, Harumi-dori, Aoyama-dori: vase-shaped); pine = Japanese black pines (the 2,000 pines of Kokyo Gaien on open lawn, Hama-rikyu, Kyu-Shiba-rikyu, the moat banks: low, dark, layered) and other conifers; park = camphor and mixed evergreen broadleaf (the palace woods, shrine groves, parks); street = other street trees. Avenue trees are synthesised every 16 m on both kerbs of the named avenues and every 32 m on other major streets; park trees on a jittered grid (woods 21-32 m apart, lawns round the edge) where OSM maps none. Trees closer than 1 u to another, in water, inside building or landmark footprints, on the carriageways, on the Kokyo Gaien gravel plaza or inside the ring venue box (ring.ringClearTrees in tokyo_layout.json) are left out; synthesised street / park trees are thinned at random to keep the file at about 11,000.
